user.title: Solar Analytics
user.description:
Solar Analytics observes the Forecast.Solar profile used by the Home Assistant Energy Dashboard and compares it with your canonical PV power/energy sensors. The integration is read-only: it never controls devices, sends notifications, or triggers services.

By default, actual-PV entities and the Forecast.Solar config entry are auto-detected from the Energy Dashboard configuration. Override any field below if you want to bind to different sensors or a different Forecast.Solar entry.

data_description.actual_power_entity: The instantaneous PV power sensor (device_class=power, state_class=measurement, unit W or kW). Leave blank to auto-detect from the Energy Dashboard.
data_description.actual_energy_today_entity: The daily PV energy counter (device_class=energy, state_class=total or total_increasing, unit kWh or Wh). Leave blank to auto-detect.
data_description.forecast_source_type: Where the forecast profile comes from. 'Energy Dashboard solar-forecast integration' observes a provider such as Forecast.Solar or Solcast; 'Forecast entity' reads a timestamped profile from a chosen entity.
data_description.native_forecast_entry_id: Which Energy Dashboard solar-forecast config entry to bind to (Forecast.Solar, Solcast, ...). Leave blank to auto-detect from the Energy Dashboard's solar source. Used only when the source type is the Energy Dashboard integration.
data_description.forecast_entity_id: The forecast entity to read. Its attributes must expose a timestamped Wh-per-period map (wh_hours, wh_period, or watt_hours_period). Used only when the source type is 'Forecast entity'.
data_description.time_zone: The timezone used for the morning and day-ahead snapshot boundaries and for daily accuracy roll-ups. Defaults to Home Assistant's timezone.
data_description.morning_snapshot_hour: Local hour at which the morning-baseline snapshot is taken the day before the target day. Defaults to 06:00.
data_description.day_ahead_snapshot_hour: Local hour at which the day-ahead diagnostic snapshot is taken. Defaults to 23:00.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Solar Analytics
reconfigure.description: Change which actual-PV sensors, forecast source, timezone, or snapshot hours Solar Analytics uses. Changing the sensors or the forecast source starts a new lineage; historical accuracy stays associated with the previous lineage.

error.invalid_actual_power_entity: The selected sensor does not look like a PV power sensor (device_class=power, unit W or kW).
error.invalid_actual_energy_entity: The selected sensor does not look like a PV energy counter (device_class=energy, unit kWh or Wh).
error.invalid_native_forecast_entry: The selected forecast config entry does not exist.
error.invalid_forecast_source_type: Choose a valid forecast source type.
error.invalid_forecast_entity: Select a forecast entity that exists when the forecast source type is 'Forecast entity'.
error.invalid_snapshot_hour: Snapshot hour must be an integer between 0 and 23.
error.invalid_time_zone: The selected timezone is not a valid IANA timezone.

abort.already_configured: Solar Analytics is already configured. Use Reconfigure to change its settings.
abort.energy_manager_unavailable: The Home Assistant Energy dashboard is not available. Enable it before adding Solar Analytics.

init.title: Solar Analytics options
init.description: There are no mutable thresholds. Any change to model shape or snapshot times starts a new lineage; historical results are kept for previous lineages.

storage_failure.message: Solar Analytics storage failed with {error_type}. Analytics remain unavailable until the underlying SQLite store recovers.

canonical_actual_mismatch.title: Solar Analytics actual PV sensor mismatch

confirm.title: Reconfigure Solar Analytics
confirm.description: One of the actual-PV sensors configured for Solar Analytics is missing or does not have the expected device_class/unit ({reason}). Open Settings → Devices & Services → Solar Analytics → Reconfigure to choose different sensors, then acknowledge here.

confirm.title: Confirm the new Forecast.Solar entry
confirm.description: The Home Assistant Energy dashboard now points at a different Forecast.Solar config entry ({reason}). Open Settings → Devices & Services → Solar Analytics → Reconfigure to accept the new entry (or keep the previous one explicitly), then acknowledge here.

binding_unavailable.title: Solar Analytics has no Energy dashboard solar source
binding_unavailable.description: The Home Assistant Energy dashboard does not have a solar source configured. Add one in Settings → Dashboards → Energy, or reconfigure Solar Analytics to point at a specific Forecast.Solar config entry.

binding_ambiguous.title: Solar Analytics cannot pick a single Forecast.Solar source
binding_ambiguous.description: The Home Assistant Energy dashboard has zero or more than one solar source, or the selected source references zero or more than one Forecast.Solar config entry ({reason}). Fix the Energy dashboard configuration, or reconfigure Solar Analytics to pin a specific Forecast.Solar entry.

native_entry_unavailable.title: Forecast.Solar config entry is not loaded
native_entry_unavailable.description: The Forecast.Solar config entry Solar Analytics is bound to is unavailable ({reason}). Ensure the Forecast.Solar integration is installed and loaded, then reload Solar Analytics.

unsupported_native_contract.title: Home Assistant Forecast.Solar contract is not supported
unsupported_native_contract.description: Solar Analytics could not read the native Forecast.Solar profile from this Home Assistant version ({reason}). Upgrade Home Assistant to a supported release, or file an issue with the diagnostics attached.

state.unsupported_forecast_entity_contract: Forecast entity has no timestamped profile
